import random, sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import gateway, oracle

DIR = {"sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"],
       "sip:desk@sales.test": ["tel:+12025550122", "sip:d2@sub.sales.test"],
       "sip:trunk@trunk.test": ["tel:+15550001111"],
       "sip:x@other.test": []}
ACC = {"s1": {"primary":"sip:ember@studio.test","allow":["sip:desk@sales.test"]},
       "s2": {"primary":"sip:trunk@trunk.test","allow":[]},
       "s3": {"primary":"sip:desk@sales.test","allow":["sip:x@other.test"]}}
GW = {"edge": {"local_domains":["studio.test","sales.test"],"peers":{"p1":["trunk.test"],"p2":["studio.test","sales.test"],"p3":[]}},
      "inside": {"local_domains":[],"peers":{"edge":["studio.test"]}},
      "wide": {"local_domains":["other.test"],"peers":{"edge":["studio.test","sales.test"],"p2":["sales.test"]}}}

CLAIMS = ["sip:ember@studio.test","SIP:%65mber@STUDIO.TEST.","sip:e1@alias.studio.test","tel:+12025550121",
          "sip:desk@sales.test","sip:d2@sub.sales.test","tel:+12025550122","sip:trunk@trunk.test",
          "tel:+15550001111","sip:x@other.test","sip:nobody@studio.test","sip:ember@other.test",
          "tel:+19998887777","sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid","sip:anonymous@ANONYMOUS.INVALID."]
NON_ANON = [c for c in CLAIMS if "anonymous" not in c.lower()]

def addr(rng, pool, params=True):
    u = rng.choice(pool)
    st = rng.random()
    if st < .3: v = "<%s>" % u
    elif st < .45: v = u
    elif st < .6: v = "%s <%s>" % (rng.choice(["Alice","A B","a.b-c","\"q t\"","\"a;b,<x@y>\"","\"es \\\"c\""]), u)
    elif st < .7: v = "< %s\t>" % u
    elif st < .8: v = "%s<%s>" % (rng.choice(["Bob","x-y"]), u)
    elif st < .9: v = '"A, B" < %s >' % u
    else: v = "<%s>" % u
    if params and rng.random() < .4:
        v += rng.choice([";tag=q7"," ; tag = %s" % ("T"*rng.randint(1,40)), " ;TAG= abc ","\t;\ttag\t=\tv1",
                         ";tag=" + rng.choice(["a.b","x~y","*","+","'","("])])
    return v

def gen(rng):
    lines = []
    method = rng.choice(["MESSAGE","INVITE"])
    lines.append("%s %s SIP/2.0" % (method, rng.choice(CLAIMS)))
    lines.append("%s: %s" % (rng.choice(["From","from","f","F"]), addr(rng, CLAIMS)))
    lines.append("%s: %s" % (rng.choice(["To","TO","t"]), addr(rng, CLAIMS)))
    lines.append("%s: %s" % (rng.choice(["Call-ID","i","CALL-ID"]), rng.choice(["c","cid_1","x"*rng.randint(1,128),"a.b@c-d+e"])))
    cseq = rng.choice(["1","0001",str(rng.randint(1,2147483647)),"0"*rng.randint(1,5)+"7"])
    lines.append("CSeq: %s%s%s" % (cseq, rng.choice([" ","\t","  "," \t"]), method))
    if rng.random() < .5: lines.append("%s: %s" % (rng.choice(["Privacy","privacy"]), rng.choice(["id","none","ID","NoNe"])))
    npai = rng.choice([0,1,1,1,2,2])
    for _ in range(npai):
        n = rng.choice([1,1,2])
        members = [addr(rng, NON_ANON, params=False) for _ in range(n)]
        if n == 2:  # one sip one tel
            members = ["<%s>" % rng.choice(NON_ANON), "<%s>" % rng.choice([c for c in NON_ANON if c.startswith("tel:")])]
        sep = rng.choice([",",", "," , ","])
        lines.append("%s: %s" % (rng.choice(["P-Asserted-Identity","p-asserted-identity"]), sep.join(members)))
    if rng.random() < .35: lines.append("P-Preferred-Identity: " + addr(rng, NON_ANON, params=False))
    if rng.random() < .25: lines.append("Remote-Party-ID: " + addr(rng, NON_ANON, params=False))
    if rng.random() < .35: lines.append("%s: %s" % (rng.choice(["Content-Type","c"]), rng.choice(["text/plain","application/x-y","a\tb","x"*200])))
    if rng.random() < .3: lines.append("%s: %s" % (rng.choice(["Via","Authorization","Contact","X-Foo","Require"]), rng.choice(["<sip:a@b>;tag=z","abc","  spaced  "])))
    if rng.random() < .15: lines.append(rng.choice([" ","\t"]) + "folded tail")
    body = rng.choice(["hello","", "a\r\nb", "z"*rng.randint(1,300), "\t x", "~!@#$%^&*()_+"])
    lines.append("Content-Length: %s" % rng.choice(["%d"%len(body), "0"*rng.randint(1,4)+"%d"%len(body)]))
    return "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n\r\n" + body

def job(rng, k, prev_ok):
    j = {"gateway": rng.choice(list(GW)),
         "ingress": rng.choice([{"kind":"local","subject":rng.choice(list(ACC))},
                                {"kind":"peer","name":rng.choice(["p1","p2","p3","edge","nope"])},
                                {"kind":"untrusted"}]),
         "trusted_out": rng.random() < .5}
    if k > 0 and prev_ok and rng.random() < .3:
        j["source"] = rng.randrange(k)
    else:
        j["raw"] = gen(rng)
    return j

TALLY={}; diffs=0; total=0
for it in range(6000):
    rng = random.Random(it*7919+11)
    n = rng.randint(1,7)
    jobs=[job(rng,k,True) for k in range(n)]
    b={"directory":DIR,"accounts":ACC,"gateways":GW,"jobs":jobs}
    g1=gateway.process(b); g2=oracle.process(b); total+=n
    for r in g1["results"]:
        k2="accept" if r["status"]=="accept" else r["reason"]; TALLY[k2]=TALLY.get(k2,0)+1
    if g1!=g2:
        diffs+=1
        if diffs<4:
            for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(g1["results"],g2["results"])):
                if x!=y:
                    print("job",i,json.dumps(b["jobs"][i])[:900]); print(" gw",json.dumps(x)[:300]); print(" or",json.dumps(y)[:300])
print("total",total,"diff batches",diffs,TALLY)
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 diff_fuzz4.py 2>&1 | tail -8
